title: RVD & Sabu fight their way toward respect
summary: Rob Van Dam and Sabu begin as rivals whose athletic styles and pride repeatedly collide. The antagonism eventually supplies the foundation for their celebrated partnership.

chapters.title: Sabu wins and Van Dam refuses respect
chapters.result: Sabu defeats Van Dam, who refuses the handshake.
chapters.context: The rejected gesture makes the series about pride as well as match results.

chapters.title: Van Dam wins the rematch
chapters.context: The reversal keeps the rivalry competitive rather than resolving it with one dominant winner.

chapters.title: The stretcher match
chapters.result: Sabu defeats Van Dam in a stretcher match.
chapters.context: Their extreme escalation becomes a defining encounter before they establish a regular team.
